name: app-events-app-on-flower-hill-sky
title: Events and expense-splitting app floating above a flower meadow
whatItIs: A phone stands in a bright meadow of pink flowers under a blue sky and clouds. The screen is white and shows a location search, a large photo card of friends at a picnic with a date chip and price, and a list for ongoing splits with a black floating tab bar with a red centre button.
whatItMeans: Fresh, sunny and social; the scene matches the app's outdoors event content.
techniques: Composite the phone into a surreal landscape that matches the content.
Use a giant photo card with overlay date and price pill.
Float a dark pill tab bar with a bright central action.
Keep the UI white so the scene colours surround it.
bestFor: Mockups with a sense of place

vocabulary.definition: A mockup placed in a constructed landscape.
A large image card with overlaid info.
A prominent add button in the middle of the nav.
